entries.reason: AH999 (l.842, EXIT) is entered only by falling out of `IF WS-STORM-DRAIN = 'N'` (l.833): the true arm ends in EXEC CICS ABEND, which does not return, and the false arm needs WS-STORM-DRAIN 'Y', which only the AFCR/AFCS/AFCT arm sets (l.745) and that arm ends in EXEC CICS RETURN before END-EVALUATE (see the entry for l.833). Nothing PERFORMs or GO TOs AH999.

`IF WS-STORM-DRAIN = 'N'` (l.833) is false only when WS-STORM-DRAIN is 'Y'. It starts 'N' (l.173) and is set 'Y' only at l.745, in the WHEN 'AFCR'/'AFCS'/'AFCT' arm of EVALUATE MY-ABEND-CODE (l.716); that arm ends in an unconditional MOVE 'N' TO COMM-SUCCESS / EXEC CICS RETURN before END-EVALUATE, so l.833 is never reached with 'Y'. The AD2Z arm and the unnamed codes (EVALUATE none arm) arrive with 'N' and take the true arm (EXEC CICS ABEND).
